newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Daewoo Corp allocates US$150 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Corp allocates US$150 mln FRN.

text.p: Daewoo Hong Kong's US$150 million floating rate note issue has been allocated, arranger KDB Asia said Monday.

The notes have a final maturity of five years but can be put on the third anniversary. They carry a coupon of 55 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate and with fees pay an all-in return of 65 basis points to top-tier managers.
Arrangers and lead managers are Banque Nationale de Paris Hong Kong, with US$32 million, IBJ Asia, with US$31 million and KDB Asia, with US$32 million.
Co-arrangers and lead managers, with US$12 million each, are Chase Manhattan Asia and HSBC Markets.
Co-lead managers, with US$7 million each, are Banca Commerciale Italiana Hong Kong, DG Bank and Standard Chartered Bank.
Yamaichi International HK is a senior manager with US$5 million.
Managers are Banque et Caisse d'Epargne de l'Etat Luxembourg, with US$3 million, and Ta Chong Bank, with US$2 million.
